properties.displayName: UAV S25 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (CPU + Connection Burst)
properties.description: UAVResourceMetrics_CL에서 CpuUsagePct 5분+ 지속 고갈, UAVDatalinkConn_CL 연결 폭증 동시 탐지. 실제 컬럼: MemoryUsageMb 없음→MemoryUsageBytes(bytes), UAVId 없음. MITRE: T1499 Endpoint DoS
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let cpuMax = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxCpuUsagePct'
    | project toreal(Value));
let ResourceAlert =
    UAVResourceMetrics_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where CpuUsagePct > cpuMax
    | summarize MaxCpu=max(CpuUsagePct),
        DurationMin=datetime_diff('minute', max(TimeGenerated), min(TimeGenerated))
        by ContainerName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
    | where DurationMin >= 5
    | project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, MaxCpu;
let ConnBurst =
    UAVDatalinkConn_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | summarize ConnCount=count() by PeerIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
    | where ConnCount > 50
    | project TimeGenerated, PeerIp, ConnCount;
ResourceAlert
| join kind=leftouter (ConnBurst) on TimeGenerated
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isnotnull(ConnCount), strcat(ContainerName, "_CPU고갈_연결폭증_동시_", tostring(toint(MaxCpu)), "%"),
    strcat(ContainerName, "_CPU고갈_5분지속_", tostring(toint(MaxCpu)), "%"))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, ContainerName, MaxCpu, ConnCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S25 - Container Resource Exhaustion DoS (CPU + Connection Burst) - {{ContainerName}}
